title: AntiLeakBench: Preventing Data Contamination by Automatically Generating Benchmark Data
authors_zh: Xiaobao Wu, Liangming Pan, Yuxi Xie, Ruiwen Zhou, Shuai Zhao, Yubo Ma, Mingzhe Du, Rui Mao, Anh Tuan Luu, William Yang Wang
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器失效或奖励投机审计论文
best_for_zh: 需要审计基准污染、评估偏差或奖励投机风险的研究者。
one_line: 从截止时间后的事实变化自动构建并更新带来源证据的抗污染问答基准。
why: It offers a concrete audit surface or failure-mode dataset for Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 candidate: the central contribution audits contamination, verifier or judge failure, reward hacking, or evaluation reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Newly collected benchmark items can still encode knowledge already present in a model's training set, inflating evaluation; manual refresh is also expensive. AntiLeakBench automatically constructs question-answering benchmarks from real-world facts that changed after a declared model cutoff.

It uses updated Wikidata claims and post-cutoff Wikipedia revisions to build evidence-grounded single-hop and multi-hop items. The paper is an evaluation-contamination audit, not a method for detecting whether a particular model trained on a particular document.

新收集的基准题仍可能包含模型训练时已知的事实，从而抬高评测分数；人工更新也成本高。AntiLeakBench 自动从模型知识截止时间后的真实世界变化构造问答基准。

它用更新后的 Wikidata 事实和截止时间后的 Wikipedia 修订构造带证据的单跳、多跳题。这是评测污染审计，而非判断某模型是否训练过某篇文档的方法。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: AntiLeakBench treats freshness as a verifiable data contract rather than a publication date. It identifies a fact whose object changed after a model cutoff, retrieves a supporting revision, and turns the evidence into QA with gold, distractor, and multi-hop variants. The official repository releases the benchmark-building code and data; the main contribution is an automatically refreshable contamination-resistant evaluation surface.
AntiLeakBench 将“新鲜性”视为可核验的数据契约，而非发布日期。它找出模型截止时间后对象发生变化的事实，检索支持该事实的修订，并生成 gold、干扰文档和多跳问答变体。官方仓库公开构建代码和数据；核心贡献是可自动更新、抗污染的评测面。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Sample time-qualified claims from Wikidata.
  2. Detect a post-cutoff object change and exclude reversions.
  3. Retrieve a post-change Wikipedia revision; retain it only when its summary contains the subject and object or aliases.
  4. Build single-hop or chained multi-hop QA, optionally add unrelated documents, and evaluate with EM/F1 or accuracy/F1.
  5. Refresh with a new Wikidata dump. Fix cutoff, dump, revision times, templates, and human-verification protocol.

1. 从 Wikidata 抽取有时间限定的事实。
  2. 识别截止时间后对象变化，并排除回到旧对象的情况。
  3. 检索变化后的 Wikipedia 修订；只有摘要含主体和对象或别名时保留。
  4. 构造单跳或链式多跳问答，可加入无关文档；用 EM/F1 或 accuracy/F1 评测。
  5. 下载新 Wikidata dump 后更新；须固定截止时间、dump、修订时间、模板和人工核验协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Human verification reports context accuracy of 97.3% for single-hop gold and 98.7% for multi-hop gold; answer accuracy is 96.7% and 97.3% (Table 3). These figures support item quality, while source errors and cutoff assumptions remain possible.
人工核验中，单跳 gold 的上下文准确率为 97.3%，多跳为 98.7%；答案准确率分别为 96.7% 和 97.3%（表 3）。这支持题目质量主张，但来源错误和截止时间假设仍可能存在。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier live benchmarks mainly collect recent data. AntiLeakBench changes the acceptance rule: a fact and its support must be demonstrably post-cutoff, then the pipeline generates and refreshes the item without human authoring. The contribution is this provenance-linked construction contract.
既有 live benchmark 多收集近期数据。AntiLeakBench 改变接受规则：事实及其证据必须可证明发生在截止时间后，再无人工撰题地生成和更新样本。贡献是带来源约束的构造契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors limit automation to QA because other tasks make embedded knowledge and automatic sample quality hard to verify. Wikidata and Wikipedia can contain errors. Reuse should sample-check claims, revisions, and aliases before treating the benchmark as contamination-free.
作者把自动化限于问答任务，因为其他任务难识别嵌入知识并自动保证样本质量。Wikidata 和 Wikipedia 也可能含错误。复用前应抽样核验事实、修订与别名，不能直接假定基准绝对无污染。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it to evaluate retrieval or long-context QA after a declared cutoff. Supply source snapshots, build items, and report gold and distractor performance with provenance checks. Do not use it to establish general reasoning quality beyond time-sensitive factual QA.
可用于在声明的知识截止时间后评测检索或长上下文问答。提供来源快照，构建样本，并连同 gold、干扰文档表现与来源核验一起报告。它不适合证明超出时效事实问答的通用推理能力。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Freshness is verified by claim history and revision time.
  2. Supporting documents, not model generation, ground QA.
  3. Table 3 reports 96.7-98.7% human-verified accuracy.
  4. Cutoff and source provenance are the key controls.
  5. Audit each update before use.

1. 新鲜性由事实历史和修订时间核验。
  2. 问答由支持文档而非模型生成内容支撑。
  3. 表 3 的人工核验准确率为 96.7%-98.7%。
  4. 截止时间和来源链是关键控制项。
  5. 每次更新后都应审计。
